title: CPU sampling client
responsibility: Refreshes browser CPU observations and explicitly reports unavailable samples.

inputs.name: analyticsCpuClient.update
inputs.description: Callback receiving a parsed CPU snapshot, or null when an active request fails.

outputs.name: analyticsCpuClient
outputs.description: Returns refresh and stop. Starts one request immediately and polls every five seconds while visible; overlapping requests are skipped. Stop cancels the timer and aborts the request, suppressing subsequent delivery.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A non-success HTTP response creates CPU sample unavailable. internally; refresh catches failures and delivers null while active.
